title: PHON: Phononic Orchestration Notation
description:
A declarative DSL for programming phononic (acoustic) computing circuits. Programs specify physical media, wave components, and signal flow using frequencies, phases, and amplitudes. Includes a reference simulator (idealized complex amplitude and 1D FDTD) and an LLM-assisted code generation pipeline.

The language specification is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0; the reference implementation is licensed under Apache 2.0.
